name: 60626 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60626 (Chicago) has 180 nonprofit organizations. 88 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 75 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60626 (Chicago) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
